column4: CONFIRMED lineage biology: E-prime genuinely comes in two size classes -- 94 aa in SHFV and 110 in Free State vervet virus, 52 aa in Pebjah and Southwest baboon virus -- and it is absent or truncated by a premature stop codon in four further simian arteriviruses (PMID 25187550). This is the labile member of the duplicated cassette and the reason it must not carry copy_num; Cai 2021 (PMID 33917085) shows ORF2b' is not required for replication in vitro.

CONFIRMED record defect, not a bin defect, and it is documented upstream: the two 270 aa members are Zambian malbrouck virus 1 (NC_048209), the one simian arterivirus record that annotates no GP4 at all and whose GP3/GP4 boundary is unresolved. Every other GP3 in the subfamily is 136-204 aa. Kept rather than dropped because the sequence is a real GP3-region product; the module calls it as GP3 and the register is the submitter's.
